test_static_dataclass_frozen: test that StaticDataclass instances are immutable and raise FrozenInstanceError on field assignment
test_static_dataclass_eq: test that StaticDataclass equality compares field values and class identity, excluding subclasses
test_static_dataclass_hash: test that StaticDataclass hashing includes field values and class identity for consistent cache keys
test_static_dataclass_defaults: test that StaticDataclass supports default field values with correct initialization
test_static_dataclass_hash_by_id_metadat: test that hash_by_id metadata allows fields hashing by id while enforcing value-based hashing otherwise
